title: Snake dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7CFF6B'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#4FD84A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2EAE38'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='snakeBelly' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#EFFF9A'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C6F05A'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- shadow / ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='30' ry='4' fill='#2A5E2A' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- tail curl bottom right -->
  <path d='M72 80 Q82 82 84 72 Q86 62 76 60' fill='none' stroke='#2EAE38' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 80 Q82 82 84 72 Q86 62 76 60' fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- main S-curve body -->
  <path d='M30 86 Q22 76 30 66 Q38 56 52 56 Q66 56 70 46 Q74 36 64 30 Q54 24 46 30'
        fill='none' stroke='#1E8A28' stroke-width='14' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 86 Q22 76 30 66 Q38 56 52 56 Q66 56 70 46 Q74 36 64 30 Q54 24 46 30'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBody)' stroke-width='10' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- belly stripe hint -->
  <path d='M30 80 Q25 73 31 65 Q38 57 50 57 Q63 57 67 48 Q70 40 63 34'
        fill='none' stroke='url(#snakeBelly)' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- little arms raised in dance -->
  <path d='M48 62 Q43 52 36 50' fill='none' stroke='#3CC240' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#9EFF8A'/>
  <path d='M58 62 Q64 52 72 50' fill='none' stroke='#3CC240' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='73' cy='49' r='2.5' fill='#9EFF8A'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#3CC240'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='28' rx='14' ry='11' fill='#4FD84A' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='25' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#7CFF6B' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- snout / jaw -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='31' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#2EAE38'/>
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='29' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#4FD84A'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FFF8B0'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='24' r='2' fill='#1E3A20'/>
  <circle cx='39.8' cy='23.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='24' r='3.5' fill='#FFF8B0'/>
  <circle cx='49' cy='24' r='2' fill='#1E3A20'/>
  <circle cx='49.8' cy='23.2' r='0.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- happy mouth -->
  <path d='M35 32 Q39 36 44 33' fill='none' stroke='#1E6A24' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- tongue out, dancing -->
  <path d='M28 32 L22 33 L25 30' fill='none' stroke='#FF6B9A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='20' r='2.5' fill='#FFE86B'/>
  <path d='M20 16 L20 24 M16 20 L24 20' stroke='#FFF4A0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='25' r='2' fill='#FF8EC8'/>
  <path d='M80 21 L80 29 M76 25 L84 25' stroke='#FFC0E0' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='55' r='2' fill='#8AD8FF'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#FFE86B'/>
</svg>
